# haistudy

> ID: haistudy (haistudy.site) adalah platform belajar pintar all-in-one untuk mahasiswa BINUS University di Indonesia. Satu aplikasi web berisi materi lengkap tiap mata kuliah, quiz interaktif, flashcards 3D, AI study assistant, chat & forum real-time, voice room belajar bareng, dan progress tracking — diorganisir per periode ujian (UTS / UAS). Dibuat oleh mahasiswa BINUS, independen dan tidak terafiliasi dengan BINUS University. Antarmuka & konten berbahasa Indonesia (id-ID).
> EN: haistudy (haistudy.site) is an all-in-one smart study platform for BINUS University students in Indonesia. A single web app with complete per-course material, interactive quizzes, 3D flashcards, an AI study assistant, real-time chat & forum, voice study rooms, and progress tracking — organized per exam period (UTS / UAS). Built by a BINUS student, independent and not affiliated with BINUS University. Interface and content are in Indonesian (id-ID).
> Search aliases / kata kunci pencarian: "haistudy", "hai study", "haistudy app", "haistudy.site", "platform belajar BINUS", "platform belajar anak Binus", "platform belajar mahasiswa", "aplikasi belajar mahasiswa Binus", "website belajar Binus", "belajar persiapan ujian Binus", "rangkuman kuliah Binus", "kisi-kisi ujian Binus", "BINUS study platform", "Binus exam prep", "study app for university students Indonesia".

## About haistudy / Tentang haistudy

ID: haistudy adalah platform belajar berbayar (juga bisa dipasang sebagai aplikasi/PWA di Android, iOS, dan desktop) yang membantu mahasiswa BINUS University mempersiapkan ujian. Daripada catatan tersebar dan grup chat yang berantakan, semua kebutuhan belajar untuk satu periode ujian ada di satu tempat: rangkuman, kisi-kisi, materi per modul, quiz, flashcards, AI tutor yang dilatih dari materi kuliah, dan komunitas belajar (chat, forum, voice room). Konten dipisah per periode ujian dan jurusan, sehingga tiap angkatan melihat materi yang tepat untuk periodenya. Saat ini fokus pada mahasiswa BINUS jurusan Business Management. Tagline: "Study Smarter, Not Harder."

EN: haistudy is a paid web platform (also installable as a PWA on Android, iOS, and desktop) that helps BINUS University students prepare for exams. Instead of scattered notes and messy group chats, everything needed for one exam period lives in one place: summaries (rangkuman), exam topic grids (kisi-kisi), per-module material, quizzes, flashcards, an AI tutor trained on the course material, and a study community (chat, forum, voice rooms). Content is namespaced per exam period and major, so each cohort sees exactly the right material for its period. Currently focused on BINUS Business Management students. Tagline: "Study Smarter, Not Harder."

## Who it's for / Untuk siapa

ID:
- Mahasiswa BINUS University (Bina Nusantara), terutama jurusan Business Management (Manajemen).
- Mahasiswa yang sedang menyiapkan ujian tengah semester (UTS) dan ujian akhir semester (UAS).
- Siapa pun yang mencari sumber belajar BINUS yang lengkap dan rapi, dengan AI assistant dan komunitas belajar.

EN:
- BINUS University (Bina Nusantara) students, primarily the Business Management major.
- Students preparing for mid-term exams (UTS) and final exams (UAS).
- Anyone looking for a complete, organized BINUS exam-prep resource with an AI assistant and a study community.

## Subjects & topics / Mata kuliah & topik

ID: Materi disusun per periode ujian untuk BINUS Business Management, Semester 2. Tiap mata kuliah mencakup materi per modul, rangkuman, kisi-kisi, flashcards, dan quiz per kategori. Daftar topik di bawah adalah garis besar pembahasan (bukan materi berbayar itu sendiri).

EN: Material is authored per exam period for BINUS Business Management, Semester 2. Each subject includes per-module material, summaries (rangkuman), exam topic grids (kisi-kisi), flashcards, and category quizzes. The topic lists below are the high-level outline (not the paid material itself).

### Semester 2 — UTS (mid-term)

- Statistics I: Introduction to Statistics; Describing Data (frequency tables, frequency distributions, graphic presentation); Describing Data — numerical measures; Introduction to Probability; Continuous Probability Distributions; Discrete Probability Distributions.
- Business Economics: The Economics and Business Environment; Business Organisations; The Consumer and Demand; Price Elasticity; Costs of Production; Revenue and Profit; Profit Maximisation under Perfect Competition and Monopoly; Business in a Competitive Market; Digital Marketing using AI; Profit Maximisation under Imperfect Competition; Multinational Corporations in a Global Economy; Business Strategy in a Global Economy.
- Character Building: Kewarganegaraan (Civics): Introduction to Civics Education; Values and Social Norms; State and Constitution; Rights and Obligations of the State and Its Citizens; Law Enforcement in Indonesia; The Dynamics of Democracy in Indonesia; Wawasan Nusantara.
- Accounting for Business: Introduction to Financial Statements; The Accounting Information System; Accrual Accounting Concepts; Merchandising Operations and the Multiple-Step Income Statement; Fraud, Internal Control, and Cash; Statement of Cash Flows; Financial Analysis — the big picture.
- Foundations of Artificial Intelligence: Introduction to AI; Machine Learning Fundamentals; AI and Data; Natural Language Processing; Speech Recognition; Computer Vision; Video Processing.

### Semester 2 — UAS (final)

- Business Ethics: Ethical Decision Making — Technology & Privacy in the Workplace; Ethical Decision Making — case study discussion; Ethics and Marketing; Business and Environmental Sustainability; Ethical Decision Making — Corporate Governance, Accounting & Finance.
- Operations Management: Location Strategies; Inventory Management; Aggregate Planning and S&OP; Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and ERP; Short-Term Scheduling; Maintenance and Reliability.
- Accounting for Business: Managerial Accounting; Cost-Volume-Profit Analysis; Incremental Analysis; Budgetary Planning; Budgetary Control & Responsibility Accounting.
- Foundations of Artificial Intelligence: AI with IoT; AI and Robots in Our Lives; AI in Entertainment and Gaming; AI and Society — Shaping the Future; Ethics of AI.

## Features / Fitur

ID:
- Materi Lengkap: materi per modul, rangkuman, dan kisi-kisi untuk setiap mata kuliah di periode ujian aktif.
- Flashcards Interaktif: kartu bolak-balik 3D dengan shuffle dan progress tracking.
- Quiz Berbobot: soal per kategori dengan scoring otomatis dan leaderboard.
- AI Study Assistant: tanya materi kapan saja; AI menjawab berdasarkan materi di platform untuk periode ujian aktif.
- Live Support: chat langsung dengan admin dari dalam aplikasi, atau via WhatsApp / Instagram.
- Komunitas: global chat real-time, forum diskusi, @mention, reply, voice message, dan notifikasi instan.
- Voice Room: belajar bareng lewat panggilan suara langsung dari browser (buat room, lock, share screen).
- Catatan pribadi dengan Markdown + rumus matematika (KaTeX), bookmark, dan progress tracking per akun yang tersinkron antar perangkat.
- PWA: pasang ke layar utama untuk pengalaman fullscreen seperti aplikasi native + notifikasi.

EN:
- Complete material: per-module material, summaries, and exam topic grids for every course in the active exam period.
- Interactive flashcards: 3D flip cards with shuffle and progress tracking.
- Weighted quizzes: questions per category with automatic scoring and a leaderboard.
- AI study assistant: ask about the material anytime; the AI answers from the in-platform material for the active exam period.
- Live support: chat directly with the admin from inside the app, or via WhatsApp / Instagram.
- Community: real-time global chat, discussion forum, @mentions, replies, voice messages, and instant notifications.
- Voice rooms: study together over a live browser voice call (create rooms, lock them, share screen).
- Personal notes with Markdown + math (KaTeX), bookmarks, and per-account progress tracking that syncs across devices.
- PWA: add to home screen for a full-screen, native-app-like experience with push notifications.

## AI study assistant / AI Study Assistant

ID: AI menjawab secara ketat berdasarkan materi yang ada di platform untuk periode ujian aktif (rangkuman, flashcards, kisi-kisi) serta informasi fitur haistudy — AI tidak membahas materi periode lain. Teks ditenagai DeepSeek V4 (model Pro untuk VIP/Diamond, Flash untuk lainnya, dengan mode reasoning/berpikir opsional); gambar yang di-upload dibaca oleh Google Gemini. Mendukung "Tanya AI" pada teks materi yang disorot. Jawaban AI bisa tidak selalu akurat — selalu verifikasi dengan materi dosen.

EN: The AI answers strictly from the in-platform material for the active exam period (summaries, flashcards, kisi-kisi) plus haistudy feature info — it does not cover other periods' material. Text runs on DeepSeek V4 (Pro model for VIP/Diamond, Flash for others, with an optional reasoning/thinking mode); uploaded images are read by Google Gemini. Supports "Ask AI" on highlighted material text. AI answers may not always be accurate — always verify against the lecturer's material.

## Community & collaboration / Komunitas & kolaborasi

ID: Pengguna di periode ujian yang sama berbagi ruang yang sama: global chat real-time (dengan @mention, reply, voice message, gambar, polling), forum diskusi per mata kuliah, voice room untuk belajar bareng, dan Direct Message antar anggota (fitur VIP/Diamond). Notifikasi instan untuk mention, reply, pengumuman, dan polling.

EN: Users in the same exam period share the same spaces: real-time global chat (with @mentions, replies, voice messages, images, polls), per-course discussion forum, voice rooms for studying together, and Direct Messages between members (VIP/Diamond feature). Instant notifications for mentions, replies, announcements, and polls.

## Packages & pricing / Paket & harga

ID: Akses dijual per periode ujian (sekali bayar, per UTS atau per UAS). Semua paket berbayar membuka konten belajar yang sama (semua mata kuliah, quiz, flashcards, AI assistant, forum/chat, voice room). Harga dalam Rupiah (IDR):

- Share — Rp 25.000: konten penuh, dengan syarat membagikan link haistudy ke teman. (Promo kelas LE86: Rp 20.000 untuk share ke 2 teman di luar kelas.) Maks. 2 perangkat.
- Normal — Rp 30.000 (paling populer): konten penuh, tanpa syarat share. Maks. 2 perangkat.
- VIP — Rp 35.000 (best price-to-value): semua fitur Normal, plus model AI eksklusif (DeepSeek V4 Pro) dengan prioritas & limit chat lebih tinggi, VIP Lounge, Direct Message (DM), Snippet Library, warna aksen/highlight kustom, font premium, perks voice room, badge VIP, dan support lebih cepat. Maks. 3 perangkat.
- Diamond — Rp 50.000: semua fitur VIP, plus efek nama "glow" eksklusif di seluruh aplikasi (chat global, forum, DM, voice room, profil), badge Diamond, dan status supporter yang langsung mendukung pengembangan haistudy. Maks. 3 perangkat.

Tersedia Preview Gratis (tanpa login) di /preview untuk mencoba sebelum membeli.

EN: Access is sold per exam period (one-time, per UTS or per UAS). All paid packages unlock the same study content (all subjects, quizzes, flashcards, AI assistant, forum/chat, voice rooms). Prices in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR):

- Share — Rp 25,000: full content, requires sharing the haistudy link to friends. (LE86 class promo: Rp 20,000 for sharing to 2 friends outside the class.) Up to 2 devices.
- Normal — Rp 30,000 (most popular): full content, no sharing requirement. Up to 2 devices.
- VIP — Rp 35,000 (best price-to-value): everything in Normal, plus the exclusive AI model (DeepSeek V4 Pro) with priority & higher chat limits, VIP Lounge, Direct Messages (DM), Snippet Library, custom accent/highlight colors, premium fonts, voice-room perks, a VIP badge, and faster support. Up to 3 devices.
- Diamond — Rp 50,000: everything in VIP, plus an exclusive glowing name effect across the whole app (global chat, forum, DM, voice room, profile), a Diamond badge, and supporter status that directly funds haistudy's development. Up to 3 devices.

A free preview (no login) is available at /preview to try before buying.

## How to get access / Cara mendapatkan akses

ID:
1. Buka haistudy.site dan pilih paket (Share, Normal, VIP, atau Diamond).
2. Isi formulir pembelian di website.
3. Bayar via transfer bank, e-wallet, atau QRIS.
4. Unggah bukti bayar di formulir.
5. Admin memverifikasi pembayaran dan mengirim license key via WhatsApp.
6. Masukkan license key di halaman login untuk mulai belajar.

Login memakai license key (platform tidak memakai akun email/password). Sign-in Google juga didukung untuk menautkan sesi.

EN:
1. Open haistudy.site and pick a package (Share, Normal, VIP, or Diamond).
2. Fill in the purchase form on the website.
3. Pay via bank transfer, e-wallet, or QRIS.
4. Upload the payment proof in the form.
5. The admin verifies the payment and sends a license key via WhatsApp.
6. Enter the license key on the login page to start studying.

Login is by license key (no email/password accounts). Google sign-in is also supported for linking a session.

## Payment methods / Metode pembayaran

ID: Transfer bank (BCA), e-wallet (GoPay, ShopeePay, DANA, OVO), dan QRIS. Sejumlah angka unik kecil ditambahkan ke harga agar admin bisa mencocokkan transfer masuk dengan pembeli yang tepat.

EN: Bank transfer (BCA), e-wallet (GoPay, ShopeePay, DANA, OVO), and QRIS. A small unique amount is added to the price so the admin can match each incoming transfer to the right buyer.

## Platform & access / Platform & akses

ID:
- Aplikasi web di https://haistudy.site, bisa dipasang sebagai PWA di Android, iOS, dan desktop.
- Bahasa: Indonesia (id-ID).
- Perangkat: maks. 2 per akun (Share/Normal) atau maks. 3 (VIP/Diamond), diverifikasi via device fingerprint.
- License key berlaku 30 hari sejak aktivasi.
- Preview Gratis tanpa login di /preview.

EN:
- Web app at https://haistudy.site, installable as a PWA on Android, iOS, and desktop.
- Language: Indonesian (id-ID).
- Devices: up to 2 per account (Share/Normal) or up to 3 (VIP/Diamond), verified via device fingerprint.
- A license key is valid for 30 days from activation.
- Free preview without login at /preview.

## Privacy summary / Ringkasan privasi

ID: haistudy menyimpan: license key, nama & kelas (ditampilkan di chat/forum/voice room), device ID (fingerprint untuk batas perangkat), kontak opsional, pengaturan, progress belajar, pesan chat/forum/support, percakapan AI, notifikasi, catatan, bookmark, presence, serta activity & error logs. Data dipakai untuk autentikasi, fitur belajar/komunitas, sinkronisasi antar perangkat, support, dan perbaikan platform. Data server di Supabase (PostgreSQL + Row Level Security), media di Cloudinary, voice via LiveKit, hosting di Vercel; gambar ke AI dikirim langsung ke provider tanpa disimpan. Pengguna bisa minta hapus/ekspor data dan menyembunyikan status online. Teks lengkap di /privacy.

EN: haistudy stores: license key, name & class (shown in chat/forum/voice rooms), device ID (fingerprint for the device limit), optional contact, settings, study progress, chat/forum/support messages, AI conversations, notifications, notes, bookmarks, presence, and activity & error logs. Data is used for authentication, study/community features, cross-device sync, support, and platform improvement. Server data on Supabase (PostgreSQL + Row Level Security), media on Cloudinary, voice via LiveKit, hosting on Vercel; images sent to the AI go straight to the provider without being stored. Users can request data deletion/export and hide their online status. Full text at /privacy.

## Terms summary / Ringkasan ketentuan

ID: License key bersifat personal dan tidak boleh dibagikan; maks. 2 perangkat per key (verifikasi fingerprint); berlaku 30 hari sejak aktivasi. Penyalahgunaan (berbagi, menjual ulang, meminjamkan) → blokir permanen tanpa refund. Dilarang: berbagi key, kecurangan akademik, konten ilegal/spam/SARA, menyalahgunakan @mention/@all, meretas/mendecompile, mendistribusikan ulang konten tanpa izin, memakai bot. Materi bersifat edukatif dan rangkuman — bukan pengganti materi resmi dosen (selalu rujuk BINUSMAYA). Layanan disediakan "sebagaimana adanya" tanpa jaminan hasil ujian. Teks lengkap di /terms.

EN: A license key is personal and must not be shared; up to 2 devices per key (fingerprint verification); valid 30 days from activation. Misuse (sharing, reselling, lending) → permanent ban, no refund. Prohibited: sharing keys, academic cheating, illegal/spam/hateful content, abusing @mention/@all, hacking/decompiling, redistributing content without permission, using bots. Material is educational and summarized — not a replacement for official lecturer material (always refer to BINUSMAYA). The service is provided "as is" with no guarantee of exam results. Full text at /terms.

## Policies / Kebijakan utama

ID:
- Independen: dibuat oleh mahasiswa; TIDAK terafiliasi, didukung, atau disetujui oleh BINUS University. Seluruh materi kuliah, merek, dan hak cipta milik pemiliknya masing-masing.
- Tanpa refund setelah license key diterbitkan — coba Preview Gratis dulu.
- Tanpa berbagi akun: pemakaian dilacak real-time per perangkat; berbagi atau login di perangkat tak terdaftar membuat akun dibanned dan key hangus permanen.

EN:
- Independent: built by students; NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by BINUS University. All course material, trademarks, and copyrights belong to their respective owners.
- No refunds after a license key is issued — try the free preview first.
- No account sharing: usage is tracked in real time per device; sharing or logging in on an unregistered device gets the account banned and the key permanently revoked.

## FAQ

ID:
- Apa itu haistudy? Platform belajar pintar all-in-one untuk mahasiswa BINUS: materi tiap mata kuliah, quiz interaktif, flashcards, AI assistant, voice room, dan komunitas, diorganisir per periode ujian.
- Apakah resmi / terafiliasi BINUS? Tidak. Platform independen buatan mahasiswa BINUS, tidak terafiliasi atau didukung BINUS University.
- Universitas & jurusan apa? BINUS University, fokus Business Management (Semester 2), untuk periode UTS dan UAS.
- Bagaimana cara akses? Pilih paket → isi formulir → bayar (transfer/e-wallet/QRIS) → unggah bukti → admin kirim license key via WhatsApp → masukkan key di halaman login.
- Beda paket Share dan Normal? Konten sama persis. Share lebih murah tapi wajib share link ke teman; Normal langsung akses tanpa syarat share.
- Keuntungan VIP? Model AI eksklusif (DeepSeek V4 Pro) dengan prioritas & limit lebih tinggi, VIP Lounge, DM, Snippet Library, warna aksen kustom, font premium, perks voice room, badge VIP, dan support lebih cepat.
- Apa itu Diamond? Semua fitur VIP plus efek nama "glow" eksklusif di seluruh haistudy, badge Diamond, dan bentuk dukungan langsung untuk pengembangan haistudy.
- Berapa device? Maks. 2 (Share/Normal) atau 3 (VIP/Diamond). Butuh lebih → hubungi admin.
- Bisa preview dulu? Bisa, gratis tanpa login di /preview.
- Mata kuliah apa saja? Tergantung periode ujian aktif untuk Business Management Semester 2 (UTS: Statistics I, Business Economics, CB Kewarganegaraan, Accounting for Business, Foundations of AI; UAS: Business Ethics, Operations Management, Accounting for Business, Foundations of AI).
- Apakah AI-nya akurat? AI menjawab berdasarkan materi periode ujian aktif di platform; selalu cek dengan materi dosen.
- Apa fitur voice room? Belajar bareng via panggilan suara dari browser; bisa buat room, lock room, dan share screen.
- Cara hubungi admin? Menu Layanan Pelanggan di sidebar → tab Chat untuk live chat; atau via WhatsApp/Instagram.
- Boleh sharing akun? Tidak. Sistem keamanan melacak pola pemakaian device real-time; aktivitas sharing → akun dibanned dan key hangus permanen tanpa peringatan.
- Ada refund? Tidak ada refund setelah License Key diterbitkan; pastikan sudah lihat Preview Gratis sebelum membeli.

EN:
- What is haistudy? An all-in-one smart study platform for BINUS students: per-course material, interactive quizzes, flashcards, an AI assistant, voice rooms, and a community, organized per exam period.
- Is it official / affiliated with BINUS? No. Independent, made by a BINUS student, not affiliated with or endorsed by BINUS University.
- Which university & major? BINUS University, focused on Business Management (Semester 2), for UTS and UAS exam periods.
- How do I get access? Pick a package → fill the form → pay (transfer/e-wallet/QRIS) → upload proof → admin sends a license key via WhatsApp → enter the key on the login page.
- Share vs Normal? Identical content. Share is cheaper but requires sharing the link to friends; Normal gives instant access with no sharing requirement.
- VIP benefits? Exclusive AI model (DeepSeek V4 Pro) with priority & higher limits, VIP Lounge, DM, Snippet Library, custom accent colors, premium fonts, voice-room perks, a VIP badge, and faster support.
- What is Diamond? All VIP features plus an exclusive glowing name effect across haistudy, a Diamond badge, and a way to directly support haistudy's development.
- How many devices? Up to 2 (Share/Normal) or 3 (VIP/Diamond). Need more → contact the admin.

- Which subjects? Depends on the active exam period for Business Management Semester 2 (UTS: Statistics I, Business Economics, CB Kewarganegaraan, Accounting for Business, Foundations of AI; UAS: Business Ethics, Operations Management, Accounting for Business, Foundations of AI).
